__help: A value left out (or a broken file): the default of the mod; a type left out: its default.
SkillDmgRatios: damage bonus per expertise level, SkillExpRatios: expertise exp per use in a battle / a month of practice, by type (None, SkillLeft, SkillRight, Step, Ability, Ultimate).
AutoArtifactExpRate: artifact expertise exp a month; BattleArtifactExpRate: per use in a battle.
